priorCohortBinding.earlierBoundary: Prism action is a real candidate, not a task gap; the complete surface-support contract was too broad. Historical decision remains unchanged.

surfaceSupport.unchangedWholeContract: Use properties of simple solids to calculate lateral and total surface areas in suitable situations. No restriction to right prisms or a single formula/body instance.

removedWholeContracts.reason: Volume and cubic measurement are distinct from exterior area and are not a universal preparation requirement for an appropriately dimensioned surface task.

The complete length/angle contract includes oblique prisms/pyramids and vector representations. These are not needed before every suitable surface calculation; some applications may still need them explicitly.
Analyzing all edge/face/spatial-direction relations is a broader independent competence. Elementary parallel/right-angle recognition remains in the retained foundation.
Identifying all axes/planes of symmetry is not necessary for summing or otherwise calculating exterior surface areas. Symmetry can be useful without being a universal prerequisite.

newWholeContracts.reason: Identifying/naming elementary solids supplies general geometric orientation; the body list remains broader than prisms. Assigning lateral/base/exterior surface parts remains content of the consumer goal.
Area measurement, appropriate decomposition and units supply the general plane-area foundation. The complete parallelogram/triangle/trapezoid/composite-figure contract is read and retained.

surfaceSupport.scopeOfMinimality: A justified local direct prerequisite set; no claim that the inherited elementary arithmetic/geometry graph is globally minimal. Specific circle/sector or vector methods remain available when a concrete body task needs them, without becoming universal entry gates.

examPreparation.reason: The actual scored action uses body properties to identify and compute exterior face areas. This is a real application of the general surface method after removal of unrelated compulsory support. It is not justified merely by a desired route-count improvement.
examPreparation.overlapWithExistingPrismSkill: The existing specific f1348d40 contract already describes this prism instance fully; the overlap is real. Adding the general preparation edge adds no mathematical task action and no separate learner result. This review approves didactic preparation, not a claim that the narrower instance proves every application of the broader goal.
examPreparation.coverageReason: The existing assessment is bound to a right triangular prism. Its rubric directly secures the narrower whole prism-area contract. A separate lateral-area result or transfer to broader body cases is not explicitly demanded. The solution summing lateral faces is not itself an extra learner obligation or a reviewed full-generalization claim.
examPreparation.coverageBoundary: This does not impose a general rule that every broad skill always requires two body types, nor does it assert a new task gap. A separate future broad-coverage decision would need an explicit assessment-sampling justification or actual changed task/rubric evidence. Neither is silently invented here.
